question: Does a first retest after a volume-backed 15m displacement in a fully aligned 4h/1h trend have positive expectancy after stress costs?

prior_failed_families.S16: RSI/Connors-RSI pullback failed; H1 does not use oscillator oversold/overbought entries.
prior_failed_families.S17: generic order-block retest with a 5R/trailing exit failed; H1 requires a break of an objective 20-bar extreme, first retest, 5m confirmation and a fixed 1.5R P0 target.
prior_failed_families.S53: market entry on displacement failed; H1 never chases the impulse and uses a post-confirmation limit retest.

setup.displacement: 15m close through the prior 20-bar extreme by 0.05 ATR, body >= 0.80 ATR, volume >= 1.20x prior-20 median, close in outer candle quartile
setup.pullback: first touch within eight 15m bars of a +/-0.10 ATR breakout-level zone without closing beyond the displacement-origin stop
setup.confirmation: directional 15m rejection body >=0.25 ATR plus closed 5m break of the prior two 5m bars
setup.entry: limit at the breakout-zone edge for 30 minutes; never chase at market
setup.session: confirmation from 06:00 inclusive to 18:00 exclusive UTC so a four-hour hold ends before 22:00 UTC
setup.stop: beyond the displacement candle origin plus 0.15 ATR; natural distance 0.60%-1.25%

gates.development_stress: at least 40 fills, net PnL > 0, PF > 1.10 and mean net R > 0
gates.validation_stress: at least 20 fills, net PnL >= 0, PF >= 1.00, at least two positive symbols, largest symbol <=60% of gross profit
gates.promotion: a historical pass authorizes only a new frozen paper-forward plugin; live remains disabled

no_parameter_search: Exactly one configuration. Any parameter change creates a new strategy ID and protocol.
